usages.explain: Indicates being inferior even to the subject mentioned in the noun, used for criticism or condemnation.

examples.content: あんたの皮なんか、牛以下だよ。
examples.transcription: あんたのかわなんか、うしいかだよ。
examples.mean: Your skin is worse than that of a cow.

examples.content: 動物の虐待する人は人間以下だと思います。
examples.transcription: どうぶつのぎゃくたいするひとはにんげんいかだとおもいます。
examples.mean: I think people who abuse animals are less than human.

title: ... いかだ => Not as good as ..., even worse than ..., not ...
